_comment: Sample `pull_request` event payload for `act` (Lot 1, PLAN_SOLIDITE_TECHNIQUE.md — see ci-local/README.md). act's default event has no pull_request.number, which every path-filtered `changes` job (dorny/paths-filter) needs. Swap `number` for a real, existing PR on this repo before running a job that reads file lists — dorny/paths-filter queries the GitHub API for that PR's changed files rather than diffing locally, so a fake number just returns 0 files.
